body:
Implement Ticket 2 of the canonical spec .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md (section 5 'Ticket 2', section 4.2, section 4.5.2) as amended by its NORMATIVE Appendix A (read it first; it overrides the body). Branch feat/t-plugin-02-adlc-bridge in worktree .worktrees/t-plugin-02, stacked on T-PLUGIN-01-CORE.

Build (test-first):
1. Appendix A D12: booster-owned vendor/adlc/ (package.json, bin/adlc.mjs, dist/adlc.bundle.mjs) whose dispatcher statically imports ONLY rails-guard, gate-manifest, flail-detector, hollow-test, consensus-fix, model-router, merge-forecast, ticket from these packages, each added as an exact-pinned devDependency at the @adlc/cli version (1.11.1): rails-guard -> @adlc/rails-guard, gate-manifest -> @adlc/gate-manifest, flail-detector -> @adlc/flail-detector, hollow-test -> @adlc/hollow-test, consensus-fix -> @adlc/consensus-fix, model-router -> @adlc/model-router, merge-forecast -> @adlc/merge-forecast, ticket -> @adlc/tickets (bin adlc-tickets); any other verb exits 1 with 'verb not vendored'. `npm run vendor:bundle` builds it with esbuild 0.28.2; `npm run build` rebuilds dist/ and vendor/adlc/; the CI drift gate already covers vendor/.
2. scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs: verifies the npm registry integrity of each source package in package-lock before writing digests.
3. lib/adlc-bridge.mjs: IS_BUNDLED = typeof __AGB_BUNDLED__ !== 'undefined' && __AGB_BUNDLED__ === true; KNOWN_ADLC_DIGESTS (binarySha256, treeDigest, vendoredBundleSha256 for vendor/adlc/); KNOWN_ADLC_DEPENDENCY_DIGESTS with the 1.7.0 tree digest of the extracted vendor/cache/adlc-antigravity-1.7.0.tgz computed by lib/digest.mjs (Appendix A.4 item 15) so T3 never edits this file; Tier 1 vendored adlc is the only tier when IS_BUNDLED, fail closed with 'vendored-adlc-tampered' on any digest mismatch; Tiers 2-4 only when !IS_BUNDLED and the un-spoofable dev invariant of section 4.2 holds; when IS_BUNDLED every override env var (AGB_DEV_MODE, AGB_DEV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_PLUGIN, ADLC_CLI_PATH, AGB_ADLC_BIN, AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI, AGB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ADLC, AGB_PLUGIN_DIR, ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_PATH) is ignored. Every adlc call still returns {ok:false,error} rather than throwing.
4. lib/scheduler.mjs: imports unionActiveRails from lib/active-rails.mjs; if the store is unreadable (railsPresent) or active tickets declare rails and rails-guard fails authentication or errors, block dispatch and merge of every ticket (section 4.2 enforcement gate); audit gates (gate-manifest, flail-detector) only warn.
5. Appendix A D14/E8: runAgy in lib/agy.mjs (the single spawn choke point) injects AGB_WORKER_TICKET=<ticketId> for agb run workers and AGB_WORKER_MODE=readonly for review, sweep, prosecute, preflight, plan/brain; a caller passing neither gets AGB_WORKER_MODE=readonly.
5b. Plugin contract enum (deferred here by T-PLUGIN-01-CORE; T3 freezes lib/adlc-bridge.mjs so it must land now): readPluginContract returns exactly PLUGIN_CONTRACT_STATUSES (spec section 4.4): plugin.json absent -> 'unreadable'; invalid JSON or missing/non-semver version (lib/semver.mjs parse) -> 'corrupt'; adlcContract absent -> 'tolerant'; === SUPPORTED_PLUGIN_CONTRACT -> 'compatible'; any other value -> 'incompatible'. Update every consumer of the old 'missing-field' status in lockstep — lib/scheduler.mjs:1031 (checkEnforcementAvailable), lib/bootstrap.mjs:114, lib/doctor.mjs:81 — as a STATUS RENAME ONLY ('tolerant' keeps today's degrade behaviour; 'corrupt' degrades like 'unreadable'); the bootstrap/doctor decision-table rewrite stays in T-PLUGIN-03. Test: test/handshake.test.mjs cases for all five statuses; grep -rn "missing-field" lib/ bin/ mcp/ returns nothing.
6. Appendix A.6 items 12-14: section 4.2 tier reachability, D12 authentication inputs, and post-run integrity verification in lib/scheduler.mjs (pre-dispatch tree digests of both staged plugins plus hooks-dir hash listings via git rev-parse --git-path hooks, compared after each worker; any difference or rails-guard failure marks the run compromised and blocks merge; test/scheduler-integrity.test.mjs).
7. CODEOWNERS adds vendor/adlc/**, lib/adlc-bridge.mjs, scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs. CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `npm test` passes with new tests: test/adlc-bridge-bundled.test.mjs (importing the bridge unbundled does not throw ReferenceError; system PATH ignored without AGB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ADLC=1; env overrides ignored when bundled; tampered vendor/adlc bundle fails closed without fallthrough; tampered vendor/cache tarball fails SHA-512 check; tarball containing ../ rejected before extraction), test/scheduler-fail-closed.test.mjs (unauthenticated adlc blocks merge when rails are declared; corrupt shard blocks merge), test/agy-worker-env.test.mjs (env markers for each runAgy caller and the default).
2. `node --test test/vendor-adlc-smoke.test.mjs` runs each of the 8 vendored verbs' --help from a git ls-files copy with node_modules deleted, all exit 0.
3. `node --test test/clean-home-run.test.mjs` (fixture repo, fake agy, vendored adlc only) shows rails-guard ok:true and a gate-manifest entry.
4. `npm run build && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all dist/ vendor/` prints nothing.
5. `adlc rails-guard --base 1335212 --ticket T-PLUGIN-02-ADLC-BRIDGE` exits 0 (bin/node-launcher.sh, bin/hook-runner.sh, lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs untouched).
6. `adlc hollow-test --test-cmd "npm test" --base 1335212` has no survivors in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs or the scheduler gate path.
7. `npx adversarial-review --base 1335212` exits 0.
title: Vendor a static adlc dispatcher with digest pinning, mark every agb-spawned agy session as a worker, and fail the scheduler closed
